title: A laptop for 4K editing in DaVinci Resolve under $1,800
prompt: Pick a laptop for a film student who edits 4K in DaVinci Resolve, budget $1,800, four candidates.
note: Light and sans, with the winner as a bordered card directly under the title so the pick and its total are on screen before the arithmetic, and the three runners-up as a small column inside that card. Weights are a table with horizontal bars scaled to the heaviest criterion, scores are a heatmap grid with laptops as rows and a bold total column, and sensitivity is two prose paragraphs that each restate every recomputed total, because a student comparing on a phone reads better than they click.
